observations: Photo 0 shows a long, corrugated metal sheet with a silver-gray top surface and a bright blue bottom edge. The sheet has a ribbed profile with visible seams and a textured pattern on the top surface. The environment appears to be a warehouse or yard with concrete flooring and other roofing sheets nearby.

Photo 1 shows a similar long, corrugated metal sheet, but with a dark, almost black top surface and a silver-gray bottom edge. The sheet has the same ribbed profile and is laid on a concrete floor. Other roofing sheets in green and red are visible in the background.
Both photos show the sheets lying flat on the ground, with no visible branding or model markings on the surface.
The watermark 'TOP KEN ROOFING SOLUTIONS' is present on both photos, suggesting the seller's business name, but not the product brand.
